5:24.text: ! We shall never enter it as long as they are there. So go you and your Lord and fight you two, we are sitting right here."

5:25.text: said: "O my Lord! I have power only over myself and my brother, so separate us from the people who are the Fâsiqûn

5:26.text: is forbidden to them for forty years; in distraction they will wander through the land. So be not sorrowful over the people who are the Fâsiqûn

5:27.text: the story of the two sons of Adam
in truth; when each offered a sacrifice
, it was accepted from the one but not from the other. The latter said to the former: "I will surely kill you.
" The former said: "Verily, Allâh accepts only from those who are Al-Muttaqûn

5:28.text: "If you do stretch your hand against me to kill me, I shall never stretch my hand against you to kill you : for I fear Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn

5:29.text: "Verily, I intend to let you draw my sin on yourself as well as yours, then you will be one of the dwellers of the Fire; and that is the recompense of the Zâlimûn

5:30.text: encouraged him and made fair-seeming to him the murder of his brother; he murdered him and became one of the losers.

5:31.text: Then Allâh sent a crow who scratched the ground to show him to hide the dead body of his brother. He
said: "Woe to me! Am I not even able to be as this crow and to hide the dead body of my brother?" Then he became one of those who regretted.
